units.source_text: “他之前正在写什么来着，”哲学家马咯似是辩解般地自言自语着，接着拿起桌子上的那张纸。

en.t: What was he writing just now? the philosopher Maro muttered to himself as if making an excuse, then picked up the sheet of paper on the table.

units.source_text: 除我而外，大家都伸长了脖子，隔着马咯宽阔肩膀看那张纸上的字。

en.t: Everyone except me craned their necks and looked at the writing on the paper over Maro's broad shoulders.
It was written there as follows:
